notes: «أنه سمع أباه، يحدث أنه سمع جابرا» : «أباه» is named only by relation (rule 5 and rule 7), then Jabir is the Companion who tells the saying.
«عن حجة النبي» names the subject of the report, not a link; it is left out.

fixes.reason: RWY reads «حجة» as a transmitter; in the text it is the topic of the report («عن حجة النبي»), not a link.
